snippet.title: Hex Judge | Official Release Trailer (English)
snippet.description:
The verdict has been delivered. But was it the truth?

Interrogate villagers, uncover their secrets, and decide who will burn at the stake before sunset.

Hex Judge is an AI-assisted medieval witch trial investigation game powered by a local LLM. Every interrogation can unfold differently based on your questions, the villagers’ personalities, and their relationships.

Features

* AI-driven dynamic interrogations
* 30+ unique villagers in the full version
* Randomly selected suspects each playthrough
* Villager editor (full version)
* Multiple endings
* AI-generated epilogues
* Retro pixel art inspired by the 1980s

Available on Steam – July 16, 2026

Wishlist / Store Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4508120/Hex_Judge/

Developed by CheetahTownGames
